labs.name: Lab A - cookie only
labs.description: Servidor aceita qualquer cookie valido. Sem IP/device/anti-bot binding.
labs.notes: Baseline. Replay direto deve AUTHENTICATED em todas as variants.

labs.name: Lab B - cookie + IP binding
labs.description: Servidor exige IP do login original. Cookie em outro IP rejeita.
labs.notes: Replicas via SOCKS5 no IP da vitima = AUTHENTICATED. Replicas de outro IP = ANONYMOUS ou CONTEXT_BOUND.

labs.name: Lab C - cookie + device binding
labs.description: Servidor exige fingerprint do navegador original.
labs.notes: Replicas com fingerprint preservado = AUTHENTICATED. Default = CONTEXT_BOUND ou ANONYMOUS.

labs.name: Lab D - OAuth front-channel
labs.description: Server valida tokens via IdP mock (Google-like). Cookie sozinho nao basta; API reconhece, UI exige re-auth.
labs.notes: CookieMonster deve classificar como IDP_BOUND com reason 'identity_provider_boundary:*'.

labs.name: Lab E - OAuth + MFA
labs.description: IdP exige MFA. Cookie sozinho nao basta.
labs.notes: CookieMonster deve classificar como MFA_BLOCKED com mfa_challenge detectado.

labs.name: Lab F - anti-bot challenge
labs.description: Server retorna challenge JS (Cloudflare-like) antes de aceitar request.
labs.notes: CookieMonster deve classificar como BOT_BLOCKED com bot_challenge detectado.

labs.name: Lab G - rotating session
labs.description: Server invalida cookie apos N requests (forca re-login).
labs.notes: CookieMonster deve classificar como INCONCLUSIVE com hint 'session_token'.
